name: Trade Status 6 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a trade in a central matching and settlement system.

SMAP.name: Settlement Mature Pending
SMAP.definition: Trade has been selected for settlement and is pending.

SPLI.name: Split
SPLI.definition: Trade has been split into subtrades for settlement efficiency.

SMAT.name: Settlement Mature
SMAT.definition: Trade has been selected for settlement.

FUMT.name: Fix Unmatched
FUMT.definition: For NDF instructions, if a party has submitted both the open and fix confirmations and the counterparty is yet to submit the open and fix confirmation the instruction is updated to ‘Fix Unmatched’ Status.

NETT.name: Netted
NETT.definition: Trade has been netted by the central system.

PFIX.name: Partial Fix
PFIX.definition: For NDF instructions, open confirmations are matched and the Fix confirmations are not matched.

OMTC.name: Open Matched
OMTC.definition: For NDF trades, the trade is marked as open match when both open confirmations from both parties match.
